2608.25897.title: Towards A Unified Information Bottleneck Framework for Time Series Explanations
2608.25897.paper_summary: Explaining deep learning models operating on time series data is crucial in various applications that require transparent and interpretable insights into model behavior. {Existing explanation methods generally fall into two categories: attribution-based explanations, which identify the temporal regions most responsible for a prediction, and counterfactual explanations, which reveal how an input should be modified to alter the model's decision.} {Despite valuable insights, these two fields are largely studied independently. This disconnect leaves attribution methods lacking causal validation, while counterfactual methods suffer from severe instability, producing adversarial-like noise instead of meaningful explanations.} In this work, we revisit time-series explainability from an information-theoretic perspective and show that existing explainers are vulnerable to trivial solutions and distributional shifts. To address these limitations, we propose a unified objective function for explainable time series learning that bridges attribution and counterfactual reasoning within a single framework. Building upon the Information Bottleneck principle, our formulation explicitly prevents trivial explanations and out-of-distribution counterfactuals. {Based on this objective function, we introduce {\modelname}, a novel explanation framework that learns a parametric transformation network to construct explanation-embedded instances, where preserved information yields attribution explanations and controlled information removal produces stable counterfactual explanations.} We evaluate {\modelname} on synthetic and real-world benchmarks against state-of-the-art baselines. Extensive quantitative and qualitative results show that {\modelname} consistently outperforms competing methods, yielding faithful attributions and stable counterfactual explanations.
2608.25897.paper_summary_zh: 解釋運行於時間序列數據的深度學習模型在各種應用中至關重要，這些應用需要對模型行為提供透明且可解釋的見解。{現有的解釋方法一般可分為兩類：基於歸因的解釋，這類解釋識別出對預測最有責任的時間區域，以及反事實解釋，這類解釋揭示了如何修改輸入以改變模型的決策。}{儘管提供了有價值的見解，這兩個領域在很大程度上是獨立研究的。這種脫節使得歸因方法缺乏因果驗證，而反事實方法則遭受嚴重的不穩定性，產生類似對抗的噪聲，而不是有意義的解釋。} 在這項工作中，我們從信息論的角度重新審視時間序列的可解釋性，並顯示現有的解釋器容易受到平凡解和分佈變化的影響。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一個統一的可解釋時間序列學習目標函數，將歸因和反事實推理橋接在一個框架內。基於信息瓶頸原則，我們的公式明確防止平凡解釋和超出分佈的反事實。{基於這個目標函數，我們介紹了{\modelname}，一個新穎的解釋框架，該框架學習一個參數變換網絡來構建嵌入解釋的實例，其中保留的信息產生歸因解釋，而控制的信息移除則產生穩定的反事實解釋。} 我們在合成和現實世界的基準上對{\modelname}進行了評估，並與最先進的基線進行比較。大量的定量和定性結果顯示，{\modelname}始終優於競爭方法，產生忠實的歸因和穩定的反事實解釋。
